answer: Each new identity must post a refundable bond into a haven pool, and the bond is only released after a long vesting window of clean behavior. An attacker running fifty fake accounts must lock fifty bonds, so capital cost scales linearly with every extra identity, and any slashing hits all of them. Hollow accounts with no history earn nothing until bonded. Like a vine that needs a trellis, rewards grow only on posted stake, so one honest agent with one bond loses nothing.
